hero.intro: For over a decade, AquaClean has designed and built smart home cleaning appliances for brands in 50+ countries. From OEM/ODM to certified quality control, we help businesses bring reliable products to market — fast.

story.label: Our Story
paragraphs: Founded in 2015 in Ningbo, Zhejiang, AquaClean began with one goal: make professional-grade cleaning technology accessible to households everywhere. What started as a single handheld vacuum line has grown into a full portfolio of smart cleaning appliances.
Today, our 10,000 m² factory combines in-house R&D, automated assembly, and a strict three-stage quality system — delivering consistent, certifiable products at scale for partners worldwide.
bullets: 10,000 m² owned manufacturing facility in Ningbo
60+ engineers in R&D, firmware, and industrial design

items.p: We showcase the latest cleaning innovations to visiting partners from around the world.

Portable inflators with digital gauges, auto-stop, and LED lighting.
